# A `payment:` block whose `amount:` is finer than the currency.
#
# `18.191` on a split line is refused, and it is the same figure on the same
# invoice — a booked amount is a whole number of the currency's own units, and
# which line of the block states it does not change that. This one reached
# `string_to_gnc_numeric_quantity`, which parses at a fixed millionth and
# refuses nothing, so the payment path was the last place the rule was not
# applied.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming 18.191 and the cent, and no
# payment.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_amount_must_fit_the_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-CENT"
	name: "Cent Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CENT-001"
	customer_id: "C-CENT"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-CENT-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 18.191
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Payment for INV-CENT-001"
